interest: Shows Forbes's 1930 Imperial Stud visit and a Japanese wool-industry rationalization docket.
overview: File 894.62211 (1930): one sheet records Forbes's Hokkaido Imperial Stud visit; a second, bundled sheet on wool indexes Neville's report on the Temporary Industrial Rationalization Bureau's plan to rationalize and amalgamate Japan's woolen industry.

people.name: Edwin L. Neville
people.role: U.S. Chargé d'Affaires ad interim to Japan

subfiles.about: State Department List of Papers docket sheet indexing a report on horse breeding in Japan and Ambassador Forbes's visit to the Imperial stud in Hokkaido.
subfiles.summary: Indexes a 1930 report on Japanese horse breeding and Forbes's Emperor-approved visit to the Hokkaido Imperial Stud.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Horse Breeding in Japan (894.62211)

subfiles.about: State Department List of Papers docket sheet indexing an entry on the rationalization and amalgamation of the Japanese woolen industry.
subfiles.summary: Indexes Neville's 1930 report on plans to rationalize and amalgamate Japan's woolen industry, discussed by the Temporary Industrial Rationalization Bureau.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Rationalization of the Japanese Wool Industry
